issues.claim: "True Shield Insurance Agency" - website https://trueshieldinsuranceagency.com/, town Edison, address Unknown
issues.problem: The cited domain does not resolve (DNS lookup failed on fetch). No Edison NJ listing for this agency was found in any search; the only similarly named business surfaced was True Shield Insurance Agency LLC in Argyle, Texas. The entry gives no address and no phone, so the claim that it operates in Edison is unsupported.
issues.fix: Remove the entry, or re-add only if a NJ DOI licence, Edison address or live site is verified.

issues.claim: "Eisner & Lubin LLP" - 100 Menlo Park, Edison, 732-321-2000, iBegin only
issues.problem: No Edison office could be found. The firm's New Jersey office was reported at 2 King Arthur Court, North Brunswick; the firm merged into WithumSmith+Brown and the NJ office closed. The only page carrying the Edison address is the same iBegin bulk directory the mapper already flagged as potentially stale.
issues.fix: Remove the entry; the Edison address is not supported by any current source.

issues.claim: "J.H. Cohn, CPA" - 333 Thornall Street, Edison, 732-549-0700, iBegin only
issues.problem: J.H. Cohn ceased to exist in 2012 when it merged into CohnReznick. The Edison address appears only in historical court filings. As CohnReznick this is a top-20 national accounting chain, which the mapper's own rules exclude (Grant Thornton, RSM and Amper Politziner were excluded on that basis).
issues.fix: Remove the entry: defunct name plus an excluded chain type.

issues.problem: The Edison Chamber listing itself shows the practice trading as "Taxassist advisors", a franchise brand. If TaxAssist is a franchise network, this is a franchisee and falls under the mapper's franchise exclusion; the mapper noted the ambiguity but included it anyway.
issues.fix: Triage should confirm whether the practice is an independent CPA LLC merely using the brand or an actual franchisee; drop it if the latter.

issues.claim: "Cornell Insurance Services (Foundation Risk Partners)" - 105 Fieldcrest Avenue
issues.problem: Part of a national insurance brokerage consolidator; the mapper flagged it as possibly ineligible. It is the only brokerage in the list that belongs to a national group.
issues.fix: Confirm group ownership before outreach; exclude if the brief's chain rule covers consolidator-owned agencies.

issues.problem: The name indicates a professional association rather than an accounting practice, and the only evidence is a single bulk directory. Including an association as a prospect is a type error.
issues.fix: Verify what the entity is; remove if it is an association.

issues.claim: "Tvisha Technologies Inc." - Edison, LinkedIn company page only
issues.problem: LinkedIn gives 505 Thornall St, Edison, but the firm's own contact page shows only a 'New Jersey' office with no Edison address, and a search-engine result for tvisha.com listed 33 Wood Avenue South, Iselin. Edison membership is not established from the firm's own site.
issues.fix: Verify against the firm's own contact page or NJ business registration; reclassify if the office is in Iselin (outside the zone).

issues.claim: Edison location inferred rather than stated for "Colucci Law Firm", "SA Engineering LLC", "SG Healthcare & Pharma Tech", "Leo Wealth", "Gitterman Wealth Management", "Endeavor Property Management", "Towne & Country Property Management"
issues.problem: On the cited pages I could not see an Edison street address: coluccilawfirm.com and saengweb.com do not mention Edison in page text, sghealthpharma.com shows no address, leowealth.com/contact and gittermanwealth.com/contact render only disclaimers, and tc-mgt.com's home page does not show Edison. The mapper already flagged several of these as 'inferred'.
issues.fix: Confirm each with a second source (state licence, ADV brochure, chamber listing, or the site's own contact/location page) before triage; otherwise move them to a 'to verify' bucket rather than the live list.

issues.claim: Several entries rest solely on LinkedIn 'HQ Edison' (ITCG Solutions, Soluzione, Qantler Technologies, Source Sphere, Hyperboost Marketing, VinzoTech, Opportune Title, Affiliated Engineering Laboratories, Equity Wealth Solutions)
issues.problem: LinkedIn company pages are not readable from this environment and were not re-verified; HQ town on LinkedIn is often a mailing address or the owner's home. None of these has a second independent source in the file.
issues.fix: Before outreach, require one independent confirmation (NJ business registration, chamber listing, site contact page, or directory with an Edison street address) for each LinkedIn-only entry.

issues.claim: Coverage of Edison independent IT services, staffing, engineering and title agencies
issues.problem: My own searches surfaced eligible Edison businesses absent from the list: Mentour Corp (55 Carter Dr), Naik Consulting Group (200 Metroplex Dr), Staff Management Group (314 Campus Dr), Unicorn Agency LLC (1581 Route 27, insurance), Investors Title Agency and Supreme Title Services (55 Carter Dr), plus CPA Richard Rosenman (104 Westgate Dr) in the same iBegin page the mapper mined. Eligible-found vs already-listed came out at roughly 20 of 28 (about 71%), which is marginal and leaves whole categories thin.
issues.fix: Add the verified missing businesses and re-run the IT, staffing, title and insurance searches before the zone is finalised.

issues.claim: "Alison E. Kosberg, Attorney-at-Law" - address 'Unknown (Suite 3008)', phone Unknown
issues.problem: Not a wrong entry, but the data gap is avoidable: kosberglaw.com states 2035 Lincoln Highway, Suite 3008, Edison NJ 08817 and 732-248-1212 on its own home page.
issues.fix: Fill in address and phone from the firm's site.

issues.claim: "Shamco Management Corp." and "Towne & Country Property Management" - address/website Unknown
issues.problem: Both publish Edison addresses. shamcomanagement.com/contact shows 505 Thornall Street, Suite 403, Edison NJ 08837 (phone 718-856-4900); Towne & Country is listed at 100 Menlo Park Drive, Suite 200, Edison with phone 732-212-8200 in search results, though its home page did not display the address to me.
issues.fix: Populate Shamco's address, phone and website; confirm Towne & Country's Menlo Park address on a location page.

issues.problem: The agency has its own site (allenfreemaninsurance.com) and a listed number 732-634-7114, which the Progressive locator does not show. The entry understates what is publicly available.
issues.fix: Add the phone and website; confirm whether the trading name is 'Allen Freeman Insurance Agency'.

issues.claim: Stale bulk-directory entries carried over verbatim (M R Weiser & Co, Tait Weller & Baker, Amper Politziner, Eisner & Lubin, J.H. Cohn on the iBegin accountants page)
issues.problem: Several names on that iBegin page are firms that have since merged or been absorbed (M R Weiser became Weiser LLP and was absorbed; Amper Politziner became part of Withum; J.H. Cohn became CohnReznick). The mapper excluded some of these but not all, so the exclusion is applied inconsistently.
issues.fix: Apply one consistent test to every iBegin-sourced accountant: live website or current state licence = keep, otherwise drop.

issues.claim: Zoning/radius caveat: 'Edison is roughly 7-9 miles from central Milltown so the whole township falls inside the 10-mile radius'
issues.problem: This is the mapper's inference rather than a sourced measurement; the far west edge of Edison (Raritan Center / Woodbridge border) is plausibly beyond 10 road miles from Milltown.
issues.fix: Spot-check drive distance for the Raritan Center and Menlo Park addresses before treating the whole township as in-radius.
